data.command: Can you tell me about your firewall rules?

data.text:
Firewall rules! Well, I've got a pretty standard setup here. I'm running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, and I'm using the `ufw` (Uncomplicated Firewall) package to manage my firewall rules.

As it happens, I've got a few specific rules set up to allow incoming traffic on certain ports. For example, I've got a rule that allows incoming HTTP requests on port 80, which is being handled by my trusty `nginx/1.24.0` web server. I've also got a rule that allows incoming SSH traffic on port 22, which is being handled by the `openssh-server` package. And, of course, I've got a rule that allows incoming traffic on the standard `netcat` port, 31337 (just kidding about that last one, I don't have any rules for 31337).

A bit more seriously, I've also got a rule that allows incoming traffic on the MySQL port, which is being used by my `mariadb-server` database. That's on port 3306, just in case you were wondering.

As for the actual firewall rules, I've got a bunch of them defined in the `/etc/ufw/after.rules
